name: Motegi Control Tower
scope: The standing race control tower on the first paddock at Mobility Resort Motegi, including its distinct pale upper box, open roof deck and flank access stair.
era: The standing paddock building in the original 2008 photo, independently identified in later operator circuit maps.

originalReview.notes: Exact April 2008 photograph published on Qualla. The first revision states self-made and all rights released with PD-self. The archive records the change from Ajtnk to Ajtnk~commonswiki without a change of photographer.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the exact Qualla photographer's original bytes and first release. Verified the old and current Commons account names through the public rename log.
